title: Attachment supply record (PROPOSED, DEL-01-04/NIR-v0.1 §6)
description: PROPOSED by DEL-01-04/NIR-v0.1 (R17-1; REQ-003). The identity of the content the App actually supplied at the local interface, taken when the turn input is written (AT-1...AT-6). It is App-observed: Codex reads a supplied path itself, so what Codex read and whether the provider adopted it are not observed at the 0.158.0 pin (labels fixed below). 'method' names a content-identity designation only; no algorithm is chosen (RS U-04; HOSTING U-08). Handed to the conversation view, to DEL-02-02 for draft attachments, and cited by DEL-04-03 records as an evidence reference of kind 'content identity'. No storage location is chosen (TBD-003; OI-014).

suppliedAs.description: The supplier input form used (UserInput at 0.158.0), or a thread attachment, or a draft package handed to DEL-02-02.

remoteRef.description: A URL or supplier file identity, recorded as given; the App does not fetch it.

enum: not observed: Codex reads the path itself
not applicable: content passed by reference

allOf.description: Path forms carry the local path.
